scope: Expose a non-mutating typed view of pre-R2018 linked-MTEXT column XDATA without flattening group 75/76/78/79/48/49/50 into the main entity or merging linked MTEXT records.

sources.authorityLimit: Autodesk's generic MTEXT table lists the column codes but does not fully scope the legacy container. The XDATA bracket/subkey interpretation follows the documented ezdxf implementation profile; this is not treated as an Autodesk-native semantic qualification.

behavior: Reads only the three exact ACAD XDATA brackets: ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMN_INFO, ACAD_MTEXT_COLUMNS, and ACAD_MTEXT_DEFINED_HEIGHT.

Validates bracket uniqueness, known key/value types and ranges, counted manual-height spans, and linked-handle syntax; returns NotPresent, Valid, or Malformed without changing extData. Valid is structural only and does not assert producer-wide conformance or native semantics.
Keeps group-76 metadata count, group-50 height count, group-47 declared link count, and actual 1005 handle-list length independent.
Returns linked MTEXT handles in source order and leaves each MTEXT callback/entity independent; no graph join or layout calculation is performed.
Unknown keyed column-info values stay in the original extData sequence and are not rewritten by the typed view.

profiles: ASCII and Binary imported/exported linked-MTEXT XDATA with an interleaved LINE and a forced handle-allocation gap
In-memory synthetic typed-view controls for static and dynamic-auto modes; generated ASCII/Binary transport for the dynamic-manual profile
Manual-height list and separate defined-height bracket
Metadata column count 9, declared linked count 3, and two explicit 1005 targets are retained as separate values
Unknown key 99 remains byte/order-visible in raw XDATA
Malformed typed unknown key is reported by the view and remains an atomic generic-writer refusal
limits: No physical producer sample was added or qualified.
No native CAD renderer/evaluator or independent runtime was executed.
No linked MTEXT aggregation, ordering semantics, text layout, or consumer support claim is established.
The existing generic XDATA writer remains responsible for raw preservation and 1005 remapping.

commands.notes: ASCII/Binary MTEXT scope and legacy XDATA controls passed; the fast test took about 1.4 seconds.
